units.linear: the master's unit scale (divided by its maximum when above 1), excess over the 45-60 px ring
units.stretched: ChunkedNafnetRunner.ApplyInputStretch's output (the master's own stretch), excess over the ring

notes: Reproduction of #1241 (pooled over all rigs, stretched L, clipped stars): NOT reproduced as 'real is about twice synth11 at 4-10 px' for 1 px cores (real 0.056/0.014/0.003 vs synth11 0.056/0.015/0.002 at 4/6/10 px). Per rig the 1 px core is within about 20 percent either way (ASI294MC synth11 above real, ASI585MC and ASI533MC near equal). 2 px cores: real 1.2x synth11 at 4-6 px and 2x at 10 px (0.011 vs 0.005), and ASI533MC reaches 4x at 10 px (0.008 vs 0.002).

The long tail IS reproduced for larger cores: core 3-5 px real falls under 0.003 at 29 px against 20 px for synth11; core 6+ real keeps 0.043 at 30 px against 0.007. Reported as measured, nothing tuned. The injector's outer component is therefore needed mainly for core 2+ stars and past 10 px.
